Definition: a Jevanite, or descendant of Javan
BiblicalUsage: A Jevanite is a descendant of Javan, a Greek, named among the peoples Joel says Judah was sold to. In Joel 3:6, The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians.
TheologicalSignificance: Joel names the Greeks Judah was sold to, and I take the Jevanite as proof that God sees the nations, not only Israel.
